summary.business_type: EdTech / SaaS — Japanese learning (JLPT N5–N1), content-type deep dive
top_findings: The site is 78% vocabulary pages, and 88% of them (4,613 of 5,224) have no example sentences — thin content at massive scale.
Content-generation scripts never populate seo_title/seo_description, so ~90% of learn pages fall back to the bare page title as their meta description (vocab desc = 'ときどき', kanji = '尻 - butt').
No structured data on any learn/study-guide/JLPT/curriculum page — only the site-wide Organization block. ArticleSchema exists but only blog/[slug] uses it.
0 of 8,935 learn posts have an author — no E-E-A-T authorship on a person-branded education site.
~2,250 pages (incl. 1,833 kanji) are written but sitting in draft — a large produced asset not yet earning traffic.
quick_wins: Add the summary fallback to learn-detail descriptions (LearnDetailContent.tsx:104) — one line, ~6,000 pages.
Add BreadcrumbList schema (visual breadcrumbs already exist site-wide).
Reuse existing ArticleSchema on study guides and learn detail pages.
Add /learn/kana*, /learn/curriculum, /scoreboard, and JLPT ?level variants to the sitemap.
Fix category canonical to drop the default sort=newest param ([type]/page.tsx:82).

categories.name: Vocabulary (5,229 pages, 78% of site)
what_works: Correct percent-encoded canonicals for Japanese slugs

findings.title: 88% of vocabulary pages have no example sentences
findings.description: DB: 4,613 of 5,224 published vocab items have zero examples; 4,611 have no examples and no notes. They render as word + reading + meaning only (~50-80 words). The 12% with examples average 6 good sentences.
findings.recommendation: Generate/curate 3-6 example sentences (JA+romaji+EN) per word using the existing examples table + template. Highest content ROI on the site.

findings.title: Stub meta descriptions on 93% of vocab pages
findings.description: Only 363/5,229 have seo_description; the rest fall back to the word itself. LearnDetailContent.tsx:104.
findings.recommendation: Backfill seo_description from word/reading/meaning; add summary fallback immediately.

categories.name: Kanji (423 published / 1,833 draft)
what_works: Best-templated learn type: consistent ~845-char bodies with readings, stroke count, frequency, grade, stroke-order data

findings.title: 1,833 kanji stuck in draft
findings.description: 4x the live count is written but unpublished.
findings.recommendation: QA and publish in batches with seo_description populated; ~5x the kanji corpus.

findings.title: 72% missing seo_description; no schema; 5% have examples
findings.description: 120/423 have seo_description; only 117/2,186 items have examples.
findings.recommendation: Backfill descriptions; add DefinedTerm schema; add example words.

categories.name: Grammar (560 pages)
what_works: 67% have example sentences (best coverage of structured types)

findings.title: Thinnest bodies on the site (avg 145 chars, 54% under 200)
findings.description: 303/560 grammar pages have bodies under 200 chars — too thin for a high-intent JLPT category.
findings.recommendation: Expand each with explanation, structure breakdown, when_to_use notes (column exists), common mistakes, and examples.

categories.name: Study guides (392 pages)
what_works: Genuinely rich, structured content (avg 1,451 chars; richer via lesson_blocks)
Strongest AI-citation asset on the site

findings.title: Good content, broken packaging
findings.description: Renders via LearnDetailContent so emits NO Article schema (unlike /blog/[slug]); 0/392 have OG images; only 25% have seo_description (title-stub descriptions); no author/date.
findings.recommendation: Add Article schema, OG images, real descriptions, author/date. Highest-leverage GEO win.

categories.name: Blog (21 editorial posts)
what_works: Reference implementation: full metadata, Article+Person+ImageObject schema, author fallback, dates, related posts, og:type=article

findings.title: Low volume + missing dateModified/BreadcrumbList
findings.description: Only 21 posts across 6 categories; schema lacks dateModified though updated_at exists; author Person is name-only.
findings.recommendation: Build a content pipeline; add dateModified + BreadcrumbList; enrich author with url/sameAs.

findings.title: No Course schema; N4-N1 not in sitemap; client-rendered
findings.description: JLPTContent is a client component so only the requested level's HTML is crawlable; sitemap lists only bare /jlpt.
findings.recommendation: Add Course/ItemList schema; sitemap all level variants. Do NOT add FAQPage for rich results (retired May 2026); keep FAQ as on-page/GEO content.

categories.name: Curriculum (432 lessons)
what_works: Strong taxonomy: 5 levels / 54 modules / 96 submodules / 432 lessons

findings.title: Large asset neither indexed nor clearly gated
findings.description: Individual lessons are personalized/gated and not in sitemap; hub is client-rendered with thin SSR; title lacks brand suffix; no Course schema.
findings.recommendation: Decide indexation strategy: server-render a crawlable free-preview outline + Course schema + sitemap, or keep fully premium.

categories.name: Reading / Listening / Writing / Sounds / Kana
what_works: Healthy bodies (sounds ~2,000 chars); listening has audio+transcript+questions SSR'd

findings.title: No schema; low volume; kana practice pages thin in SSR + missing canonicals
findings.description: Kana practice pages (hiragana/katakana/kanji) are client-rendered, lack canonicals, and are absent from the sitemap despite high search volume. 29 listening drafts unpublished.
findings.recommendation: Add canonicals + sitemap entries + server-rendered content for kana pages; add AudioObject/LearningResource schema; publish listening drafts.

categories.name: Rewards / XP / Gamification
what_works: Rich system: 102 badges, 9 achievements, streaks, monthly leaderboard reward engine

findings.title: Rich system with almost no indexable surface
findings.description: Dashboard/badge pages are login-gated; the 100-badge catalog is never exposed; /scoreboard is public but client-only and not in the sitemap; guide sections are seeded published=false (a re-seed would unpublish the live explainers).
findings.recommendation: Publish + harden guide sections; server-render /scoreboard top-N and sitemap it (privacy via show_on_scoreboard opt-in); build a public /badges catalog page.

findings.title: Generation scripts never write seo_title/seo_description
findings.description: scripts/generate-*.ts insert content/summary/og_image but not SEO metadata, so descriptions default to title (learn) or formulaic summary (blog).
findings.recommendation: Update generators to set seo fields + one-off backfill of the existing corpus.

findings.title: Inconsistent description fallback chains
findings.description: Blog: seo_description||summary||title. Learn: seo_description||title (no summary). Guide: short_description only (no clamp/fallback).

phases.name: Phase 1: High-leverage code fixes
items: Add summary fallback to learn-detail descriptions (LearnDetailContent.tsx:104)
Add Article/LearningResource schema to study guides + learn detail
Add missing canonicals (kana pages) + brand title (curriculum)
Fix sitemap coverage (kana, curriculum, scoreboard, JLPT variants)

phases.name: Phase 2: Populate SEO metadata at scale
items: Backfill seo_description + seo_title from structured fields (~6,000 pages)
Update generation scripts to set SEO columns going forward
Generate + backfill OG images per content type

phases.name: Phase 3: Content depth
items: Raise vocabulary example-sentence coverage from 12% toward full (biggest ROI)
Publish the 1,833-kanji draft backlog with QA
Establish authorship/E-E-A-T: /about + bylines + Person schema + Organization sameAs/logo

phases.name: Phase 4: Structural opportunities
items: JLPT: add Course schema + sitemap level variants
Rewards: publish guide sections, server-render + sitemap /scoreboard, build public /badges catalog
